verses.zh: 耶 和 華 如 此 說 ： 摩 押 三 番 四 次 地 犯 罪 ， 我 必 不 免 去 他 的 刑 罰 ； 因 為 他 將 以 東 王 的 骸 骨 焚 燒 成 灰 。
verses.en: This is what the Lord says:“Because Moab has committed three crimes[NOTE:1]—make that four[NOTE:2]—I will not revoke my decree of judgment.[NOTE:3] They burned the bones of Edom’s king into lime.[NOTE:4]
notes: Traditionally, “transgressions” (KJV, ASV, NASB, NRSV) or “sins” (NIV). For an explanation of the atrocities outlined in this oracle as treaty violations of God’s mandate to Noah in Gen 9:5-7, see the note on the word “violations” in 1:3.
Heb “Because of three violations of Moab, even because of four.”sn On the three…four style that introduces each of the judgment oracles of chaps. 1-2 see the note on the word “four” in 1:3.

Heb “I will not bring it [or “him”] back.” The translation understands the pronominal object to refer to the decree of judgment that follows; the referent (the decree) has been specified in the translation for clarity. For another option see the note on the word “judgment” in 1:3.

The Moabites apparently desecrated the tomb of an Edomite king and burned his bones into a calcined substance which they then used as plaster (cf. Deut 27:2, 4). See S. M. Paul, Amos (Hermeneia), 72. Receiving a proper burial was very important in this culture. Desecrating a tomb or a deceased individual’s bones was considered an especially heinous act.

verses.zh: 我 卻 要 降 火 在 摩 押 ， 燒 滅 加 略 的 宮 殿 。 摩 押 必 在 鬨 嚷 吶 喊 吹 角 之 中 死 亡 。

verses.en: They trample[NOTE:1] on the dirt-covered heads of the poor;[NOTE:2] they push the destitute away.[NOTE:3] A man and his father go to the same girl;[NOTE:4] in this way they show disrespect for[NOTE:5] my moral purity.[NOTE:6]

verses.en: They stretch out on clothing seized as collateral; they do so right[NOTE:1] beside every altar!They drink wine bought with the fines they have levied;they do so right in the temple[NOTE:2] of their God![NOTE:3]

verses.en: For Israel’s sake I destroyed the Amorites.[NOTE:1] They were as tall as cedars[NOTE:2] and as strong as oaks,but I destroyed the fruit on their branches[NOTE:3] and their roots in the ground.[NOTE:4]

verses.zh: 我 也 將 你 們 從 埃 及 地 領 上 來 ， 在 曠 野 引 導 你 們 四 十 年 ， 使 你 們 得 亞 摩 利 人 之 地 為 業 。
verses.en: I brought you up from the land of Egypt;I led you through the wilderness for 40 yearsso you could take the Amorites’ land as your own.

verses.zh: 我 從 你 們 子 弟 中 興 起 先 知 ， 又 從 你 們 少 年 人 中 興 起 拿 細 耳 人 。 以 色 列 人 哪 ， 不 是 這 樣 麼 ？ 這 是 耶 和 華 說 的 。
verses.en: I made some of your sons prophetsand some of your young men Nazirites.[NOTE:1] Is this not true, you Israelites?”The Lord is speaking.

verses.en: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine;[NOTE:1] you commanded the prophets, ‘Do not prophesy!’

verses.zh: 看 哪 ， 在 你 們 所 住 之 地 ， 我 必 壓 你 們 ， 如 同 裝 滿 禾 捆 的 車 壓 物 一 樣 。
verses.en: Look! I will press you down,like a cart loaded down with grain presses down.[NOTE:1]

verses.en: Fast runners will find no place to hide;[NOTE:1] strong men will have no strength left;[NOTE:2] warriors will not be able to save their lives.

verses.en: Archers[NOTE:1] will not hold their ground;[NOTE:2] fast runners will not save their lives,nor will those who ride horses.[NOTE:3]

verses.en: Bravehearted[NOTE:1] warriors will run away naked in that day.”The Lord is speaking.
